title: Sales Development Manager B2B (m/w/d)
description:
Standort: Forchheim | Vollzeit

Du sorgst dafür, dass aus einem guten Anlass ein gutes Gespräch wird.

VIAMA übernimmt für Unternehmen den laufenden Betrieb von Informationssicherheit und Governance. Unsere Kunden müssen Anforderungen wie NIS2, ISO 27001 oder TISAX nicht nur einmal umsetzen. Sie müssen sie dauerhaft betreiben.

Unser Vertrieb funktioniert deshalb etwas anders.

Wir kaufen keine beliebigen Leadlisten und erwarten von dir auch keine hundert wahllosen Kaltanrufe am Tag. Wir identifizieren gezielt Unternehmen, bei denen konkrete Signale auf einen möglichen Bedarf hinweisen. Zum Beispiel eine offene Informationssicherheitsrolle, eine laufende NIS2 Umsetzung oder andere Veränderungen im Unternehmen.

Deine Aufgabe ist es, aus diesen Signalen echte Gespräche zu machen.

Was du bei uns machst

Du übernimmst die operative Ansprache ausgewählter Unternehmen und begleitest einen Account so lange, bis klar ist, ob ein relevantes Thema für VIAMA besteht.

Dazu gehört insbesondere:

  • Du recherchierst die richtigen Ansprechpartner in unseren Zielunternehmen.
  • Du nimmst telefonisch Kontakt auf, auch über Zentralen und Assistenzbereiche.
  • Du führst erste Gespräche mit Geschäftsführern, IT-Verantwortlichen und Verantwortlichen für Informationssicherheit.
  • Du findest heraus, wo das Unternehmen bei Themen wie NIS2, ISO 27001 oder TISAX tatsächlich steht.
  • Du erkennst, ob ein konkreter Bedarf besteht und wann der richtige Zeitpunkt für ein weiteres Gespräch ist.
  • Du hältst Wiedervorlagen konsequent nach und lässt interessante Accounts nicht einfach verschwinden.
  • Du dokumentierst die wesentlichen Erkenntnisse sauber im CRM.
  • Sobald ein fachlich relevantes Gespräch entsteht, übergibst du an unseren Geschäftsführer oder einen unserer Governance-Experten.
  • Gemeinsam mit uns entwickelst du anhand echter Gespräche unsere Ansprache und unseren Vertriebsprozess weiter.

Du musst dabei keine komplexen Governance-Leistungen am Telefon verkaufen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, die richtige Person zu erreichen, die Situation zu verstehen und einen sinnvollen nächsten Schritt herzustellen.

Was wir nicht suchen

Wir suchen niemanden, der einfach möglichst viele Telefonnummern abarbeitet.

Wir suchen auch keinen klassischen Closer, der mit vorgefertigten Verkaufsskripten Druck erzeugt.

Unsere Zielgruppe besteht überwiegend aus Geschäftsführern und erfahrenen Fachverantwortlichen. Entsprechend wichtig ist uns eine Ansprache auf Augenhöhe.

Ein klares Nein ist für uns ein gutes Ergebnis, wenn wir anschließend wissen, warum ein Unternehmen nicht zu uns passt.

Was du mitbringen solltest

Du solltest gerne telefonieren und keine Scheu davor haben, Menschen anzusprechen, die dich noch nicht kennen.

Wichtig sind uns außerdem:

  • sehr gutes Deutsch und eine klare, professionelle Ausdrucksweise
  • Hartnäckigkeit, ohne aufdringlich zu werden
  • echtes Interesse daran, Unternehmen und ihre Situation zu verstehen
  • die Fähigkeit, gute Fragen zu stellen und zuzuhören
  • Selbstständigkeit und konsequentes Nachhalten
  • strukturierte Arbeit mit CRM und Wiedervorlagen
  • ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Geschäftsführung und Management
  • Neugier auf Informationssicherheit, Compliance und Unternehmensführung

Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Sales Development, Account Development oder telefonischen Geschäftskundenvertrieb ist hilfreich.

Erfahrung mit NIS2, ISO 27001 oder TISAX ist keine Voraussetzung. Das fachliche Wissen vermitteln wir dir.

Was dich bei VIAMA erwartet

Du startest nicht mit einer leeren Excel-Liste.

Wir bauen aktuell ein signalbasiertes Vertriebssystem, das relevante Unternehmen identifiziert und den Kontext für die Ansprache vorbereitet. Du bekommst damit nicht nur einen Firmennamen, sondern möglichst auch den Grund, warum ein Gespräch gerade sinnvoll sein könnte.

Unser Ziel ist nicht maximale Aktivität.

Unser Ziel sind wenige, aber qualifizierte Gespräche mit Unternehmen, bei denen wir tatsächlich helfen können.

Du arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Geschäftsführer und unserem Governance-Team zusammen. Was wir aus den Gesprächen lernen, fließt unmittelbar in unseren Vertriebsprozess ein.

VIAMA ist ein kleines, wachsendes Unternehmen. Das bedeutet kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und gleichzeitig die Erwartung, Verantwortung für den eigenen Bereich zu übernehmen.

Über VIAMA

VIAMA Leadership GmbH unterstützt mittelständische und größere Unternehmen beim Aufbau und vor allem beim dauerhaften Betrieb ihrer Governance.

Unser Schwerpunkt liegt auf Informationssicherheit und regulatorischen Anforderungen wie NIS2, ISO 27001 und TISAX.

Unser Ansatz: Technologie für das Wiederkehrende. Menschen für das Urteil.

Wir wollen Governance nicht komplizierter machen, sondern Unternehmen die operative Last abnehmen, die nach Projekten, Audits und Zertifizierungen dauerhaft bestehen bleibt.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann möchten wir vor allem wissen, wie du mit Menschen ins Gespräch kommst.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, warum diese Art von B2B-Vertrieb zu dir passt.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

VIAMA Leadership GmbH
Forchheim

Benefits

Sneak Peek: So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab:

1. Erster kurzer Austausch
Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns direkt am nächsten Tag bei dir zurück. Im ersten Schritt vereinbaren wir mit dir ein 10-minütiges Telefongespräch mit jemanden aus unserem Team. Hier schauen wir, ob es von beiden Seiten aus passt und finden dann direkt schon einen Folgetermin für den Kick-Off Call.

Im zweiten Gespräch nehmen wir uns ca. 30 - 45min. Zeit. Wir möchten dich richtig kennenlernen, wissen, was dich fasziniert und dich antreibt. Gleichzeitig bieten wir dir auch einen tieferen Blick hinter die Kulissen von Arvana und beantworten dir alle deine Fragen. Nach dem Gespräch kannst du mal alles reflektieren, sodass wir uns am nächsten Tag nochmal kurz austauschen können.

3. Team Meeting
Im letzten Gespräch möchten wir dich gerne in unser Office am Rosenthaler Platz einladen. Du lernst die Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und hast auch die Möglichkeit mit dem Team zu quatschen. description:
Bei cluetec bewegen wir uns – und zwar immer – nach vorne. Mit unserer Software für digitales Audit- und Checklistenmanagement machen wir Unternehmensprozesse effizienter und transparenter. Aber wir bieten mehr als Software: Wir leben eine Kultur, in der Engagement und Authentizität keine Buzzwords sind. Wir vertrauen einander, übernehmen Verantwortung und haben den Mut, Dinge neu zu denken.

Damit unsere Systeme genauso zuverlässig und leistungsfähig sind wie unsere Vision, suchen wir dich: einen System Administrator, der unsere IT-Infrastruktur stabil hält, weiterdenkt und aktiv mitgestaltet.


Deine Kernaufgaben

  • Betrieb, Wartung und Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Infrastruktur (Server, Netzwerke, Cloud-Umgebungen, Arbeitsplätze)

  • Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams sowie Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden bei IT-Fragen

  • Dokumentation von Systemen und Prozessen


Warum cluetec?

Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern einen Menschen, der für die Sache brennt und mit uns wachsen will. Was du bei uns findest:

  • Fortschritt 
    Stillstand ist für uns kein Status quo, sondern ein Risiko. Wir testen neue Technologien, hinterfragen alte Gewohnheiten und bewegen uns gemeinsam in eine positive Richtung.

  • Vertrauen 
    Wir kontrollieren dich nicht auf Schritt und Tritt. Wir verlassen uns auf deine Eigenständigkeit – und unterstützen dich, wenn du uns brauchst.

  • Verantwortung 
    Du triffst Entscheidungen und stehst dafür ein. Fehler sind Lernchancen. Risiko gehört dazu – Stillstand wäre riskanter.

  • Engagement 
    Wir brennen für das, was wir tun, bringen Dinge zuverlässig über die Ziellinie und lassen niemanden hängen. Wenn es brennt, springen wir füreinander ein.

  • Authentizität 
    Bei uns darfst du sein, wer du bist – mit Stärken und Schwächen. Diese Echtheit leben wir auch nach außen und schaffen damit Vertrauen, das über unser Team hinaus wirkt.


Ein konkreter Impact: Du arbeitest an der Basis unseres Erfolgs – einer stabilen, sicheren und modernen IT-Landschaft.

title: Bereichsleiter Produktion & Technik (m/w/d) mit Perspektive Geschäftsführung
description:
Manche Karriereschritte sind größer als ein neuer Job.

Diese Position ist einer davon.

Unser Mandant sucht eine Persönlichkeit, die heute bereits Verantwortung in einem produzierenden Unternehmen trägt – und sich vorstellen kann, morgen Verantwortung für ein ganzes Unternehmen zu übernehmen.

Für Menschen.

Für Technik.

Für Produktivität.

Und perspektivisch für das gesamte Unternehmen.

Der Erfolgsbetrieb st ein wirtschaftlich gesundes, inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen mit jahrzehntelanger Tradition im Maschinen- und Fahrzeugbau. Mit rund 65 Mitarbeitern entwickelt und produziert das Unternehmen hochwertige Lösungen in den Bereichen Maschinenbau, Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau.

Die Auftragslage ist solide, das Unternehmen arbeitet vollständig eigenfinanziert und verfügt über eine starke Marktposition.

Im Zuge des anstehenden Generationenübergangs suchen wir nun eine technisch versierte und unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die zunächst operative Verantwortung insbesondere für die Bereiche Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau übernimmt.

Und ausdrücklich gilt:

Diese Aufgabe darf mehr werden.

Bei entsprechender persönlicher und fachlicher Entwicklung besteht die klare Perspektive, sukzessive zusätzliche unternehmerische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich bis in die Geschäftsführung des Unternehmens hineinzuentwickeln.

Aufgaben

Sie möchten nicht den nächsten Titel auf Ihrer Visitenkarte, sondern tatsächlich mehr Verantwortung? Dann könnte diese Aufgabe der richtige nächste Schritt sein.

Im Mittelpunkt Ihrer Tätigkeit stehen zunächst die Bereiche Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau. Hier übernehmen Sie wesentliche Teile der heutigen operativen Verantwortung eines geschäftsführenden Gesellschafters und entwickeln Produktion, Abläufe und Produkte gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Team weiter.

Dabei ist der Schwerpunkt ganz bewusst auf das operative Geschäft gelegt:

  • Rund 70 % Ihrer Aufgabe liegen in Produktion, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Qualität, Produktivität und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der betrieblichen Abläufe.
  • Rund 30 % entfallen auf technische Fragestellungen, Konstruktion, Entwicklung und die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte.

Sie müssen also nicht derjenige sein, der jedes Bauteil selbst konstruiert. Aber Sie sollten Technik verstehen, Produktion mögen – und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam mit den Mitarbeitern dafür zu sorgen, dass der Laden läuft. Und möglichst jeden Tag ein bisschen besser.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • operative Verantwortung für die Bereiche Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau
  • Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Produktion und Arbeitsvorbereitung
  • kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Produktivität, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit
  • Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Produktions- und Organisationsprozesse
  • Begleitung technischer Weiterentwicklungen und konstruktiver Fragestellungen
  • Aufnahme von Impulsen aus Vertrieb, Markt und Kundenanforderungen und Überführung in praktikable technische und operative Lösungen
  • enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Einkauf und den übrigen Unternehmensbereichen
  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Ihnen zugeordneten Mitarbeiter und Führungskräfte
  • schrittweise Übernahme weitergehender unternehmerischer und kaufmännischer Verantwortung
  • enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gesellschaftern sowie der bestehenden technischen Führung im Maschinenbau

Der Geschäftsbereich Maschinenbau ist bereits heute technisch sehr gut aufgestellt und entsprechend verantwortet. Ihr operativer Schwerpunkt liegt daher ausdrücklich auf Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau.

Qualifikation

Wir suchen für diese Position ausdrücklich nicht zwingend den fertigen Geschäftsführer.

Viel spannender kann für uns die Persönlichkeit sein, die heute beispielsweise als Produktionsleiter, Betriebsleiter, Werksleiter oder technischer Leiter erfolgreich arbeitet und sich inzwischen die Frage stellt: War das schon alles – oder bin ich bereit, unternehmerisch noch einen Schritt weiterzugehen?

Idealerweise verfügen Sie über:

  • eine technische Ausbildung bzw. ein technisches Studium, beispielsweise im Maschinenbau, Fahrzeugbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld
  • mehrjährige Erfahrung in einem produzierenden mittelständischen Unternehmen
  • Führungserfahrung in Produktion, Technik, Betriebs- oder Werksleitung
  • ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Qualität und Produktivität
  • technisches Verständnis in Bereichen wie Mechanik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und/oder Elektrik
  • Erfahrung im Maschinen-, Fahrzeug-, Anlagen- oder Sondermaschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren industriellen Umfeld
  • Freude daran, nicht nur zu analysieren, sondern Dinge tatsächlich umzusetzen
  • unternehmerisches Denken und Interesse daran, sich perspektivisch auch mit kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragestellungen auseinanderzusetzen
  • einen bodenständigen, verbindlichen und wertschätzenden Führungsstil

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Sie heute bereits alle Facetten einer Geschäftsführungsposition beherrschen. Entscheidend ist, dass Sie das Potenzial und vor allem den Willen mitbringen, dort hinzuwachsen.

Benefits

Vielleicht sind Sie heute Produktionsleiter und fragen sich, wann Ihnen endlich jemand zutraut, einen ganzen Betrieb zu führen. Vielleicht sind Sie Betriebsleiter und stellen fest, dass oberhalb Ihrer heutigen Position kaum noch Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bestehen. Oder Sie haben technisch und operativ bereits viel erreicht – und möchten nun lernen, ein Unternehmen zunehmend auch aus kaufmännischer und unternehmerischer Perspektive zu führen.

Genau dafür kann diese Position eine außergewöhnliche Chance sein. Sie steigen nicht in ein sanierungsbedürftiges Unternehmen ein. Sie kommen in einen wirtschaftlich gesunden, eigenfinanzierten Familienbetrieb mit etablierten Produkten, erfahrenen Mitarbeitern und einer langfristigen Perspektive.

Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit, zunächst dort Verantwortung zu übernehmen, wo Ihre heutige Stärke liegt: in Technik und Produktion. Gemeinsam mit den Gesellschaftern können Sie anschließend Schritt für Schritt zusätzliche Verantwortung übernehmen – kaufmännisch, strategisch und unternehmerisch. Mit der klaren Perspektive Geschäftsführung.

Es erwartet Sie:

  • eine langfristige Perspektive in einem erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen
  • eine verantwortungsvolle operative Führungsaufgabe vom ersten Tag an
  • ein klar definierter Schwerpunkt in Produktion und Technik
  • kurze Entscheidungswege und unmittelbare Zusammenarbeit mit den Gesellschaftern
  • viel Raum für eigene Ideen und Verbesserungen
  • die Möglichkeit, sich gezielt in kaufmännische und unternehmerische Themen weiterzuentwickeln
  • eine echte Entwicklungsperspektive bis in die Geschäftsführung
  • eine attraktive, der Verantwortung und Ihrem Erfahrungsstand entsprechende Vergütung
  • Dienstwagen sowie weitere marktübliche Nebenleistungen

Haben Sie Lust auf ein solch spannendes Arbeitsumfeld? Und haben wir mit Ihnen als Geschäftsführer (m/w/d) vielleicht genau die richtige Person gefunden? Dann melden Sie sich zeitnah – wir freuen uns auf ein erstes Gespräch!

Für Rückfragen zu dieser Vakanz steht Ihnen Herr Marius Hebig gern jederzeit als Ansprechpartner zur Verfügung: 0151 703 44 016.

title: Commercial Account Executive

description:
🏆 What's the opportunity?

cargo.one is the AI-native operating system for air and ocean freight. Logistics still runs on manual work, disconnected tools and messy data. Since 2018 we've been building the data foundation, and the AI agents on top of it, that let freight teams quote, book and manage rates in a fraction of the time. Today more than 30,000 users across 172 countries run on us.

Ocean is our newest frontier. We've just brought ocean freight onto the platform alongside air, in one workspace powered by the same AI, and we need people who can make that ocean data rock solid from day one.

As our Content Operations QA Analyst (Ocean), you're the sharp eye that keeps this data trustworthy. Freight forwarders send us detailed rate sheets, and increasingly our AI helps process them. You'll compare the processed data with the source documents, correct discrepancies and make sure every figure is right before a customer sees it.

You'll build a strong understanding of ocean rates and surcharges so you can spot what doesn't add up. Content is the foundation much of our product rests on. This data powers the quoting of freight solutions by our customers to their own customers, the shippers: a forwarder wins that business on the rates we serve.

We're backed by leading investors, including Index, Bessemer, Point Nine, Creandum and Lufthansa, and we work remote-first in a positive, feedback-driven and genuinely fun team.

We're remote-first. You can work from (almost) anywhere cargo.one is able to employ through our partner Remote. We're a remote company, but we regularly meet in person, too.

  • Quality-check the ocean freight contracts, rates and surcharges that our partners and AI populate, cross-checking every entry against the source rate sheets and tariffs.

  • Learn how ocean rates and surcharges work so you can spot when something looks wrong.

  • Catch and correct errors before they reach our customers, keeping our data accurate and trustworthy.

  • Bonus: experience in ocean or air freight, logistics or shipping (e.g. freight forwarder, NVOCC, carrier ops).

❤️ We think you'll love working here if

  • You value building great relationships and trust with your team and manager.

  • You take real satisfaction in catching the small details that others miss.

  • You see working remotely successfully as a pioneering challenge that's constantly evolving.

  • In everything you do, you take ownership and get a kick out of exceeding expectations.

  • You love experimenting with new ideas and get excited when you find an opportunity to improve a process.

  • Faced with a choice, you'd rather take the ambitious option and grow than the easy one.

title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description:
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
  • Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.
If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection!


What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity, reflecting your impact and ownership.
  • Purpose-driven mission: Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent.
  • Flexible hybrid setup: Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus.
  • Trust and autonomy: Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows.
  • A genuinely high-impact role: Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation.
  • Dynamic environment: Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability.
  • Learning budget and quarterly hackathons: Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward.
  • A thoughtful hiring process: We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.


The role

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
  • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
  • Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 


What we need from you

  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
  • You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
  • You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
  • You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
  • Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
  • Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English


What we offer

  • Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
  • City center office location including home office option  
  • EGYM Wellpass membership support 
  • Educational budget for every employee 
  • Team events, summer & winter parties
  • Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   


Sounds good to you?

Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.   

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).


As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up.

You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions.

Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management within software development or technical delivery organisations
  • Proven end-to-end delivery ownership of cross-functional initiatives with multiple parallel workstreams – not limited to governance or status-reporting roles
  • Strong experience in stakeholder and escalation management
  • A high degree of ownership and composure in an environment of shifting priorities and ambiguity
  • Confident use of common PM tooling such as Jira, Confluence (or comparable)
  • Experience in a cloud, hosting, or IT infrastructure environment, as well as with agile scaling, PMO, or portfolio management (a plus)
  • A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification
  • Professional fluency in English; German language skills and certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PSM) are a plus

We know that you may not currently meet all of these requirements. But if you bring the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm for the role, we can achieve great things together.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.

As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

Core Responsibilities
  • Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better.
  • Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter.
  • Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and solve their problems.
  • Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves.
  • Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge.
  • Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers.

    • What We Value
  • Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science.
  • A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.
  • Experience or interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems.
  • Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.
  • Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision.
  • Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but may vary by team and location.

    • What We Require
  • Fluency in German
  • Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance

title: Senior Data Analyst - CRM (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d), you will join our global CRM team. This is an important role for CRM at Flix as we expand our capabilities, redefine our communication strategy and constantly optimize for maximum growth, as well as scalability and efficiency. We support global market growth with our marketing activities to increase repeated purchases and prevent churn. We always aim for cutting-edge technologies and a high level of innovation. By joining our team, you will be a crucial part of driving the team forward, developing our brands and customer communication throughout the globe.

About the Role

  • Own CRM analytics and reporting across 45+ markets, delivering clear visibility into performance, customer behavior, and commercial impact
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards providing real-time tracking of CRM performance, targets, and business trends
  • Deliver actionable insights on campaign performance, drivers of customer behavior, value-generating segments, and cross-market differences
  • Develop scalable, automated reporting solutions alongside deep-dive analyses and ad hoc business investigations
  • Monitor and optimize key CRM KPIs (engagement, conversion, retention, reactivation, communication effectiveness) and customer lifecycle performance
  • Partner with CRM, data, and product teams to improve segmentation, personalization, experimentation, tracking quality, and data reliability
  • Evaluate A/B tests and proactively identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities, presenting clear recommendations to senior stakeholders

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics or BI, ideally within CRM, marketing, or e-commerce environments
  • Proven track record of building dashboards and automated reporting solutions for non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong SQL expertise (CTEs, window functions, multi-table joins) in a modern cloud data warehouse, preferably Snowflake
  • Advanced Power BI skills including data modeling, DAX, and best-practice dashboard design and visualization
  • Solid understanding of marketing and CRM KPIs (conversion, engagement, attribution, customer lifetime value)
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing/CRM teams; familiarity with marketing automation tools (e.g., Braze is a plus)
  • Strong data storytelling, statistical literacy (e.g., significance testing), and a structured, detail-oriented, and autonomous working style
  • Proficiency in English

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
description:
**Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?**🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen.

Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens.

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.
  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.
  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.
  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.
  • KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.
  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.
  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.
  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.
  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.
  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.
  • Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.
  • Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.
  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.
  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice. Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein.
  • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.
  • Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.
  • Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.
  • Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.
  • Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner.

Du suchst keinen Job, in dem du nur Tickets abarbeitest, sondern möchtest eine Linux und Open Source Landschaft wirklich mitgestalten? 🚀

Marketing über alle Kanäle

title: AI Product Engineer (Fullstack)
description:
We believe talent is everywhere. The chance to live from it isn't.

Millions of creators are talented and invisible at the same time. The value they create flows to middlemen, while the brands who want to reach them are stuck in a non-transparent, fragmented market. So we built the tools to fix both sides at once.

Creators turn an account into an income: join a campaign in minutes, make something they're proud of, and get paid fairly for creativity, not follower count. Brands brief once, activate hundreds of creators, and see content live within 24 hours.

Next year, 10,000 creators will make a living from WePush. When a creator earns, a brand grows. When a brand grows, more creators earn. WePush is the fastest-growing creator marketing platform in Europe, with over 150,000 creators and 500,000+ collaborations powering brands like L'Oréal, ABOUT YOU, Zalando, and Sony Music. Two numbers matter to us: how many people make a living through WePush, and how many millions of people brands reach through them.

**Technical Overview:
**We run on a real distributed system: Angular and React frontends, a native iOS app, a Node/TypeScript application server handling booking and matching logic, a fleet of independently deployable backend services on Kubernetes, a real-time layer, a ledger that moves actual money, and a small army of scrapers. We're looking for a Fullstack AI Product Engineer who is comfortable moving across all of those layers and who uses AI agent tools as genuine leverage. We use these tools daily to read unfamiliar services, ship changes, and move fast.

Tasks

What you'll actually work on:

  • A native iOS app: SwiftUI, rewritten natively
  • Web Frontend: our marketplace apps are built in Angular, and newer internal tooling is React.
  • An application server layer: a Node/TypeScript service sitting between the frontend and the backend fleet, handling booking, scheduling/matching logic, invoicing, and PDF generation.
  • A polyglot microservices fleet, with a shrinking Hack/HHVM legacy core and a growing set of services in Node.js and Go, each independently versioned, containerized, and deployed via Helm to Kubernetes
  • A real CI/CD pipeline: GitLab CI building images with Kaniko, tag-based semver releases (nightly unstable builds, stable releases promoted through dev to test to a manually gated prod), and cross-service pipeline triggers when a shared dependency publishes
  • Scheduled workloads at scale: a couple dozen CronJobs per environment (reminders, payout checks, stat rollups, token refreshes, media polling), each independently schedulable, tunable, and killable without redeploying the whole service
  • Money movement: a ledger service backing real balances and payouts
  • A scraper fleet: services that scrape platforms which actively fight back (rate limits, bot walls, reshaped responses), running on their own schedule with their own failure modes
  • A newer AWS/serverless edge: internal tooling and some integrations are moving onto Lambda/API Gateway/DynamoDB. This is where a lot of new, greenfield work is happening

What "AI-driven builder" means here:

  • You use AI tools openly, as your default way of working, to read and understand an unfamiliar service fast, not just to generate new code. Half the job is "what does this cron job actually do and what breaks if I touch it," and AI is how you get that answer in minutes instead of a day
  • You verify before you trust: you'd catch a plausible but wrong AI suggestion before it ships
  • You can operate across languages and layers without needing to be a specialist in all of them, including ones you don't know yet
  • You respect the promotion pipeline. You don't route around dev to test to prod because it's slower

The stack you'll touch:

Angular and React on the web frontend, native iOS in SwiftUI, a Node/TypeScript application server, Node.js and Go for newer backend services, a legacy Hack/HHVM core we're winding down, Kubernetes, Helm, GitLab CI, Docker, a Formance-based ledger, WebSockets, cron-driven scheduled workloads, and a growing AWS serverless layer (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3/CloudFront)

Requirements

You're a strong fit if..

  • You've operated real distributed systems, not just built a monolith and called it done.
  • You're just as comfortable tracing a bug from a UI symptom (web or native) down through the application server into the backend that caused it as you are building the fix on either end
  • You're comfortable being dropped into someone else's code, in a language you may not know, with real production traffic on it, and using AI tools plus your own judgment to figure out how it actually behaves
  • You're honest about uncertainty. "I don't know, let me check the logs" beats a confident guess, from you or your AI tools

Not expected:

  • Any prior Hack (or R) experience. Nobody on the team learned either on purpose, and we're actively phasing both out
  • A portfolio of AI-free work. We're not testing whether you can code without tools, we're testing whether you build good software, in a real system

Benefits

This is a rare opportunity to build at the intersection of AI, creator technology, and consumer products.

WePush is backed by experienced operators from companies including Spotify, Google and many more. We’re entering our next phase of growth with the ambition, speed, and ownership of a startup, but with a proven product and strong market traction.

As an AI Product Engineer, you won’t be sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work closely with the founders and product team to turn new AI capabilities into products used by brands and creators at scale.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity package
  • High ownership from day one with the freedom to ship, experiment, and influence product direction
  • Direct access to founders and leadership with fast decisions and minimal bureaucracy
  • A team of builders: Ambitious, pragmatic, and obsessed with moving fast
  • An in-person culture in our Berlin office, with flexibility for home office days
  • Public transport pass, gym membership, recurring team lunches, and other perks
  • A front-row seat to building a category-defining technology company

Regardless of who you are, where you come from, how you look, or what music is playing in your headphones, you are welcome.

If you are a builder and move fast, this role is for you.

title: Data Lead (Advisory)
Claims Validation Handler
description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

The Claims Validation Team
The Claims Validation Team exists to help to defend Marshmallow against fraudulent activity, and to protect the company loss ratio. Fraudulent claims can result in us losing money, which can then result in driving up the premium prices for our honest customers. We’re here to stop that, by making sure that the right claims are reviewed for any policyholder or indemnity related concerns.


What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing indemnity referrals flagged by our wider claims team, where it has been identified at the point of claim that customers have misrepresented their policy details, and deciding upon the appropriate course of action for the policy and claim

  • Investigating first party claims by communicating with our policyholders by phone and email and conducting follow up investigations

  • Working proactively and efficiently to minimise leakage

  • Contacting customers regarding document requests or any necessary changes to their policy, and providing excellent customer service

  • Collaborating and building strong relationships with both the wider claims and fraud teams

  • Proactively identifying opportunities to improve our processes to help us to protect both the company loss ratio, and our honest customers

Who you are

  • You have an investigative mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • You are confident in good decision making, and can work efficiently under pressure

  • You have strong communication skills and are comfortable in liaising with other teams from across the business

  • You enjoy working in a high growth environment and are adaptable to change and balancing conflicting priorities

  • You are a self-starter who likes to take ownership

  • You take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience and enjoy interacting with our customers

  • You are tenacious and persistent; knowing when further investigation can lead to positive commercial outcomes for the business

What we're looking for from you

  • A background in fraud or claims/policy validation

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to effectively communicate with our customers

  • You are really passionate about the customer, and will go the extra mile to offer them the best service

  • Working in a fast-paced scale up means that you have to be adaptable and excited by the prospect of moving fast

  • You enjoy finding solutions to problems you come across rather than waiting on others to do this for you

  • You enjoy taking ownership of your own workload, and proactively highlight any blockers that you or your team may be facing

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

We break it up into a few stages:

  • Initial call with someone in our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • A skill-based interview where you will discuss your previous experience also with a focus on our values, our culture and your motivations with our Claims Validation Team Lead plus one other team member (1 hour)

We’ll let you know if you’re invited to an interview or not. But, as a small team with a lot of applications to consider, we can’t give personal feedback on each application.

#LI-PT1

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, Sierra, and Airtable.

Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised over $50m from top-tier investors. Most recently, Google Ventures led our series B. We’re growing 5x YoY, our customers are raving fans of the product, and our story has been covered in Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, and The Times.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

How we work

We operate with one core principle: velocity. In practice, this means we:

  • Optimize everything we do around accelerating rate of learning.

  • Do truly great work

  • Communicate openly and directly, and with full context.

All while maintaining a hard-earned reputation for craft and quality.

The role:

We're hiring our first Implementation Specialist to own how our customers first experience the product. You'll take new customers from signature to steady state: handle the configuration, run the training, and get every user live and productive across the Metaview agents that they’ve chosen to get started with.

A great implementation sets the whole relationship up for success. Done well, every end user sees value fast and the customer sees clear ROI against their own success criteria.

This is a brand new role, and there's a ton of room to define what great looks like as we build out the function. It's also one of the most hands-on seats in the company for learning how AI actually gets adopted inside a business. You'll see it happen across dozens of companies a year, up close, at a company defining the category.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Run the implementations for our most strategic customers: work through the plan for each new account, drive the setup, keep it on track, and make sure the customer always knows what happens next.

  • Build each customer’s version of Metaview: a lot of this is prompt engineering. You’ll write the instructions that tell Metaview's agents what a great candidate looks like for each role, give the agents context on the company and how it hires, build note templates around the customer's real interview process, and connect Metaview to their ATS and the rest of their stack. You’ll move customers onto the more advanced features once the basics are working.

  • Run the trainings: end user sessions, hiring manager onboarding, custom loom videos. Success is sustained and increasing usage from all users across all parts of the platform.

  • Watch adoption: spot the teams and users who haven't landed and go back in with targeted training or config changes. You're the customer's first call during the onboarding period, and you know when to pull in the rest of the team.

  • Leave things reusable: turn what you build into assets the next implementation can use, and share what you're learning about what makes onboarding land.

You might be:

  • A couple of years into implementation, onboarding or professional services at a B2B SaaS company with a complex, multi-module product.

  • Already working in the ops side of recruitment - you know the tools and the workflows as well as the hiring.

  • A Metaview power user who's already pushing the product further than most of our team.

  • None of these exactly, but you recognise yourself in the next section.

What you bring:

  • Project management. Not necessarily a previous job title, but one of your real strengths. Comfortable running several implementations simultaneously, each at a different stage with its own milestones, dependencies and stakeholders.

  • Product fluency. You like understanding how things work and you're happy in the detail. You'll learn to write a strong ideal candidate profile, work out why a sourcing search is returning the wrong candidates, and teach a hiring manager to get more from an agent. You're comfortable with configuration, integrations, data and prompts, and you use AI on your own work. Metaview experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Training and behaviour change. You can take a complex product and break it into pieces someone can actually use, you adjust when the room isn't following, and you know a session went well when people are using the thing a week later rather than when they said thanks.

  • Hospitality. You sweat the experience. Implementations are tailored to what each customer needs rather than running the same script, and you're easy to have on a call.

  • Systems thinking. You instinctively turn a one-off session into something reusable.

What we offer:

description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

Our AI product area is growing. We already have two Product Managers working across conversational AI, agentic workflows, and domain-specific automation, and we need a third to expand our capacity as the scope of AI at 9fin accelerates.

Backed by over $170M in funding (Series C), we are scaling rapidly across product, engineering, and go-to-market. AI is not a bolt-on feature at 9fin; it is the core differentiator for the next phase of the company.

You will join an established AI PM team and take ownership of a product area within our AI surface. This could span new AI-powered features for credit analysts, workflow automation for legal and financial analysis, or expanding our conversational AI into new domains. The team has already built evaluation infrastructure and quality frameworks; you will use and contribute to these rather than build them from scratch.

You will work within our product organization (eight squads across AI, data, and domain verticals) and partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, domain experts, and designers. This is a high-autonomy role with real scope to shape what 9fin's AI products can do for our clients.

 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for your area, with a focus on building and evolving our AI products

  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into problem statements that identify root causes, not just symptoms

  • Shape the next generation of agentic AI products: multi-step reasoning workflows, tool orchestration, and autonomous task completion for financial professionals

  • Demonstrate a working understanding of the challenges specific to building with LLMs, including managing hallucinations, evaluating output quality, and designing for non-deterministic systems

  • Use confidence-building methods (prototypes, user research, data analysis) to understand how users will interact with AI-powered products before committing to full builds

AI Quality & Data

  • Use the team's AI evaluation framework (LLM-as-judge protocols, quality thresholds, SME eval cycles) to validate and improve the products you ship

  • Contribute to the data strategy for your product area: annotation quality, ground truth curation, and feedback loops that improve model performance over time

  • Proactively identify and track metrics that measure client and business benefit, working with the team on continuous model evaluation and improvement

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work

  • Work with data scientists and ML engineers to bridge the gap between business needs and the technical capabilities of AI models

  • Communicate strategy, initiatives, and progress transparently across the organisation

  • Translate complex AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations into language that non-technical stakeholders can act on

  • Champion responsible AI practices: transparency in model outputs, bias monitoring, and compliance with client expectations around AI-generated content

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in FinTech or B2B SaaS, with at least 2 years focused on ML or GenAI products

  • Working knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation methods (not just "AI concepts" at a high level)

  • Experience shipping AI products where output quality is probabilistic: you know how to define "good enough" and iterate from there

  • Comfortable reading Python notebooks and SQL to interrogate model outputs and usage data

  • Track record of shipping AI products where you managed the tension between ML research/exploration and production delivery constraints

  • Collaborative leadership style with strong stakeholder management; you build relationships that empower your team to achieve outcomes

  • User-centric communication skills: you can explain AI capabilities and limitations to clients and internal stakeholders without overselling or underselling

  • You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are energised by the challenge of building something new

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, legal tech, or data/analytics platforms

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or regulatory/compliance workflows

  • Experience with NLP applied to document analysis (contracts, legal filings, financial reports)

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, tool use patterns, or multi-step AI workflows


The Opportunity

9fin is already the leading platform for legal intelligence in debt capital markets. Our proprietary AI capabilities extract and analyse legal language at scale, and our unique dataset of credit legal documentation delivers intelligence that generic AI tools simply cannot match.

Now we are investing to extend that leadership. You will lead a dedicated engineering team to define the next chapter of 9fin's legal product — going deeper on AI, building richer workflows, and expanding into the law firm segment, where we see a significant TAM opportunity that is ours to capture.

Your users sit at the centre of the debt markets ecosystem: origination teams at top investment banks, lawyers at leading law firms, and credit analysts at hedge funds and credit funds.

This is a great opportunity to shape the future of a product and a company that's using technology to revolutionise the trillion-dollar debt capital market.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Define and champion the product vision and strategy for the Covenants squad from the ground up, working closely with engineering, our legal analysts, and key customers to establish what to build and why.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from in-house legal subject matter experts (SMEs), customer interviews, customer feedback and data signals to craft a clear problem statement, articulating the root cause in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Use a range of techniques to identify and understand what users need and their workflows, across a sophisticated professional audience spanning credit analysts, portfolio managers, restructuring advisors, and law firms.

  • Impact driven: Align the team around a key outcome and effectively prioritise initiatives across multiple dimensions.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics to measure client and business benefit. Work with the team to define and manage a process for continuous model evaluation and improvement, with particular attention to the accuracy and reliability standards required in legal contexts.

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Team success: Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work.

  • Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complex legal and financial concepts to technical audiences, and similarly communicate technical capabilities to legal and credit professionals.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower the squad to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside of your team.

  • Stakeholder management: Work closely with stakeholders, including 9fin's legal analysts, credit team to gather the right input and insights. You will need to listen carefully and bring people on a journey.

AI Product Development

  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered legal document extraction and covenant analysis, ensuring outputs meet the precision standards required for professional use.

  • Partner with software and AI engineering to define evaluation frameworks for AI outputs in legal contexts, where accuracy, source attribution, and explainability are critical to user trust.

  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to novel legal workflow problems, from covenant compliance monitoring to cross-document analysis across deal histories.

About You

This role will be a great fit if:

  • You have a legal or financial markets background, or have built products for this audience. You may have started your career as a lawyer, paralegal, or credit analyst, or you may have been a PM at a legal tech company. You are able to hold a substantive conversation about credit agreements, covenant packages, and how legal language governs capital structures. A sharp PM from an adjacent domain who can demonstrate rapid domain immersion will also be considered.

  • You are a strategic thinker who thrives with a blank page. You are comfortable defining strategy from scratch, not just executing an existing roadmap. You can synthesise ambiguous inputs into a clear direction and bring a team with you.

  • You're a collaborative leader. You have an empathetic leadership style and build strong, effective relationships. You love working autonomously but are able to earn the trust of others with a collaborative style. You are great at prioritising, not afraid to say no, and excel at managing stakeholders while also being confident in voicing your own opinions and challenging others.

  • You've got hands-on experience with AI. You have experience with or a working knowledge of AI and LLMs, including how to evaluate model outputs in production environments. You understand what good looks like when AI is applied to high-stakes, precision-dependent workflows, and you can engage meaningfully with engineering teams on evaluation design and quality standards.

  • You work in an AI-native way. You use generative AI tools as a natural part of how you work: prototyping ideas, conducting research, reviewing PRDs, and building agents or automated workflows to extend your own productivity. You are comfortable using coding assistants to get things done faster and are genuinely excited about what this shift means for how product work gets done. This is not a nice-to-have. We expect our PMs to be at the frontier of how AI accelerates product development.

  • You thrive building from zero. You are energised by the opportunity to define something new rather than optimise something established. You move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct based on evidence.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.
